---
name: XLIFF translations
description: Rules for translation files.
applyTo: '**/*.xlf'
---

- Target languages: da-DK and de-DE.
- `*.g.xlf` is generated by the compiler. Never edit it.
- Update target files with the NAB AL Tools `refreshXlf` tool after a build. Don't merge by hand.
- Machine translations keep `state="needs-review-translation"`.
